capabilities: Track clients, deals, and projects as markdown notes with frontmatter fields and wikilinks
Drag deals between pipeline stages (lead, proposal, negotiating, won, lost) on a board
Log interactions and tasks inside each record's note body
Convert a won deal into a project with the link kept between them
Show a dashboard with deal funnel, due follow-ups, revenue snapshot, and active projects
extras: The manifest carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' The README includes an AI agent integration: an 'Install AI docs and templates' setting writes agent guide and entity templates into CRM/_docs/ for use with Claude Code or similar agents. There is also a one-way migration command for an earlier data model where clients held sales stage and value.
problem: CRMs usually live in a separate cloud app, so client and deal records sit outside the vault and are locked to an account.

relations.evidence: If you drive your vault with an AI coding agent (Claude Code and similar)

summary: A client, deal, and project CRM stored as plain markdown notes in a chosen vault folder, with a pipeline board, dashboard, and theme-following views.
